_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Inti Player {player_id} fil-Logħba tat-Tlieta tal-Tic Tac Toe.
Is-simbolu tiegħek hu '{symbol}'.
Tieħu t-turns billi tpoġġi s-simbolu tiegħek fuq bord 5x5 biex tiżviluppa linja ta' erba'.
Linji jista' jkun orizzontali, vertikali, jew djagonali.
Ibgħat il-mozzjoni tiegħek bl-format '[4]' biex timmarka ċellola 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format ta' ċaqliq mhux validu. Uża "[cell]" fejn iċ-ċellula hija 0 -{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Numru ta' ċellula invalidu: {cell}. Għandu jkun bejn 0 u {max_cell} .
